meta.formula_registration: D12-3: this file is the SOLE registration of the promotion trigger (the frozen formula-spec is deliberately not extended).

criterion.domain: unenforced AASR (direct path) over the pilot front candidates: per candidate, the MAX over its selected tasks of aasr_direct(mode, psi_start, k=1-A, prf, spt_scene_wa_m=task azimuth extent); spread = max - min across candidates
criterion.decision_rule: promote to the three-objective tier iff spread_db >= 6.0
criterion.derivation_chain: 6.0 dB = 2 x the hard-threshold sensitivity half-band (registered alternates -10/-14 dB around the -13 dB main value => 3 dB half-band), and >= 6 x the registered machine noise floor (AASR_CELL_MARGIN_DB 1.0 dB + <=0.2 dB halving sub-sample excess). Semantics: the spread between candidates must exceed twice the constraint machinery's own registered uncertainty before a third objective (independent AASR dimension) carries information.
criterion.design_value_disclaimer: 6.0 dB is a DESIGN preregistration (spec D7 allows it): no literature source exists for a promotion trigger; the derivation chain above is the defense, frozen BEFORE any W/H-band experiment has run.
criterion.m1nc_expectation: The M1NC anchor scenario is all-STR in narrow windows: the spread is trivially below threshold and the decision is no_promotion -- this validates the MECHANISM; informative readings come from the future W/H full matrix (ticket-12 gate-review note).
